text:
maya: Started canary rollout of nvidia-driver 575.2 to prod-gpu pool (us-west2) at 2026-03-18 13:47 UTC. Small batch of 12 nodes.
deploy-bot: deploy started for release/nvidia-575.2 -> rolling 12/12 nodes :rocket:
tom: seeing 3 nodes stuck in provisioning after reboot, serial console drops to initramfs on all three :thinking:
cheng: serial log for i-0a3f2c shows: 'modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/6.6.12-rt'
tom: dkms output from rescue on one node:
```
DKMS make.log for nvidia-575.2-575.2 for kernel 6.6.12-rt (x86_64)
make[1]: Entering directory '/usr/src/linux-headers-6.6.12-rt'
make: *** No rule to make target 'modules'.  Stop.
Error! Your kernel headers for kernel 6.6.12-rt cannot be found at
/lib/modules/6.6.12-rt/build or /lib/modules/6.6.12-rt/source.
```
maya: We built the dkms package against stock 6.6 kernels in CI; apparently RT/kernel flavor wasn't covered in the matrix. That explains the missing module dir.
alejandro: Also seeing NCCL issues on nodes that did boot — kube events show >50% correlations with driver 575: 'NCCL WARN Could not detect cuda runtime, driver mismatch' :grimacing:
cheng: trying quick mitigation: booting into rescue, chroot, run `dkms autoinstall --kernelsourcedir=/lib/modules/6.6.12-rt/build` but headers missing from our image. If we had headers in /opt/kernel-headers we'd be golden.
tom: rescue build failing with linker errors on one node: '/usr/src/nvidia-575.2/nvidia-uvm.o: undefined reference to symbol cuda_register' — feels like partial ABI mismatch not just missing headers.
maya: Pausing rollout and aborting the rest of the canary. Rolling back canary nodes to driver 570. Owners: @tom @cheng to coordinate rollback playbook. :no_entry_sign:
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-032-1 (priority P2) and page sent to eng-infra oncall.
alejandro: cost impact estimate: reprovision + troubleshooting ~120 GPU-hours in us-west2 for the next 24-48h, flagging Finance (may affect committed usage).
cheng: adding short-term guard: update rollout policy to skip nodes with kernel flavor matching '*-rt' and add a kernel-version check in the canary job. Workaround doc: /internal/playbooks/gpu-driver-rollback (link)
tom: long-term: expand dkms build matrix in our CI to include kernel-flavor variants, and add a modprobe sanity test post-boot. Also add an alert rule for 'initramfs' serial console state during rollouts.
maya: thanks all — keep thread updates short. Next update in 20m with rollback progress. :eyes:
